checks.name: cross join ticket classes
checks.sql: SELECT c.name, tc.label FROM customers c CROSS JOIN ticket_classes tc ORDER BY c.name, tc.label;

checks.name: right join unmatched orders
checks.sql: SELECT o.id, c.name, o.amount FROM customers c RIGHT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.id;

checks.name: full outer grouped counts
checks.sql: SELECT c.name AS bucket, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY bucket;
